series.description:
Represents the series to be plotted in the chart.
Each series is a mapping of data to a plot, with configurations for how to display the data.

plots.description: The plots to be displayed in the chart. Allows the splitting of the chart into multiple plots.

tsDataset.description: All the timeseries data to be plotted in the chart.

eventDatasets.description: A map of event type to dataset to be plotted in the chart.

tsThresholds.description:
The thresholds to be plotted in the chart. These correspond to one of the {@link #tsDataset} dimensions
and are automatically plotted in the chart when that dimension is plotted.

breakTimeRanges.description:
The time ranges to be visually "broken" or omitted in the chart's time axis.
When this field is populated, the chart will display visual breaks or discontinuities
for the specified time intervals, indicating periods that should not be shown as continuous,
such as missing data or scheduled downtime.

**NOTE**: These breaks will apply to all the plots.

queryKeys.description:
The query keys of that generated this
{@link UiApTimeseriesChartDataConfig}. This can be used to change the
{@link UiApTimeseriesChartRenderConfig} without having to re-execute the query.

title: Determines the data to be displayed in a {@link UiApTimeseriesChart}, and how it is displayed.
name: UiApTimeseriesChartConfig
